subject: Converting a read_cross2 object to read_cross

messages.author: 02c29f65061060ef
messages.subject: Converting a read_cross2 object to read_cross
parts:
Hi Karl, 

Is there an implementation or package that you have produced or that you know of that converts read_cross2 object to read_cross? I am trying to scan for >1 qtl in a single chromosome and did not realize that rqtl2 does not have an implementation for this. Am I right assuming this? I know that the reverse case is implemented in a package by you.

Thank you.
Roshan.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Converting a read_cross2 object to read_cross
parts:
There's not currently a method for converting R/qtl2 cross2 objects to R/qtl1 cross format.

karl
